site: KIZA area (Santa Ynez, CA), field elevation 674 ft
weather: pilot-set clear/calm; recorded wind 1-2 kt, OAT ~4 C at 6,000 ft
split_from: data/raw/2026-10-31_stall_c172sp.jsonl (one recorder session, split by aircraft title; lines unchanged)
sign_conventions: raw MSFS: pitch_deg + = nose DOWN; bank_deg + = LEFT wing down; p_dps + = roll LEFT; r_dps + = yaw right; pedals/yoke_x + = right; yoke_y + = aft
markers: landing light was not used as a marker; no pause markers between points. points are identified by time.
local_only: the .jsonl is not in git (size); ask the pilot or re-record
notes: A2A reports throttle (max ~31%) and manifold pressure (< 8 inHg) via its own variables; standard ones unusable. prop_rpm looks valid. gear position not recorded (pilot: gear up except point B). spins are prohibited in the real POH.

segments.what: power-off stall, clean, yoke 0.8: pitch break at AoA 12.9, 9 deg right
spin left, power off, clean: snap entry, 2 turns, then 4.7 flat turns with rudder held (yoke eased); opposite rudder stopped it
partial-power stall, rudder neutral: snapped left to 92 deg bank, no spin
power-on spin left: ~5 flat turns with rudder held; opposite rudder stopped it
stall with rudder neutral (right wing drop to 56 deg), then spin right 5.4 turns; opposite rudder stopped it
gear down (pilot), flaps 38 deg: spin right ~2.5 turns, steep (AoA 19-27, IAS ~55-60)
